name: asterdoc
author: asterdoc
abstract: Author, fill, validate, render and seal Asterdoc artifacts (forms, documents, checklists, bundles) on every surface: the TypeScript SDK, the asterdoc CLI, raw JSON/YAML, the AI agent tools (@asterdoc/ai-tools and its adapters) and the hosted MCP server. Topic references for fields, parties, annexes, logic, layers, templates, PDF bindings, rendering, formatting, instructions, filling and sealing, and one staged workflow for creating a form or converting a PDF form.
